caption: The drawing features a geometric design composed mainly of red and blue colors arranged in a square format on a beige or off-white background. The left side of the square contains a large, central star shape with eight points, outlined in dark blue and filled with alternating red and blue segments. The interior of the star radiates leaf-shaped blue and light blue elements. Surrounding the star are interlocking lines and diamond shapes filled with small, repeating red and blue patterns. On the right side of the composition, there is a vertical bar containing a series of blue and red circles with small blue star motifs inside or between them, forming a regular pattern. The overall drawing is symmetrical, with the patterns precisely aligned and the colors evenly distributed within the defined sections. The plain background emphasizes the central colored design.
title: Underneath Cloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
